assessor: Assistant editorial assessment of complete actual Gemini outputs; no generator self-score or human approval
methodology: The complete generated production fields and approved benchmark distinctions were inspected. This is a partial run: only Trust and Discovery returned validated storyboards. Rejected Connection candidates are retained but are not scored. No recorded read-aloud or external source audit was performed.
runSummary: Trust and Discovery returned six ordered primary stages and one final CTA. Connection exhausted bounded output repairs on pacing. This run predates the subsequent drafting-headroom and conflicting-advice fixes; see run-2026-11-14-03 for final-source validation.

evidence.hlni: Shot 4 distinguishes a task from its marking criteria, but omits the third feedback column and never demonstrates how a criterion changes preparation.
evidence.differentiation: An explanatory worksheet fits Trust but lacks the practical worked comparison promised by the approved benchmark.
evidence.coherence: The same assessment question progresses across all six stages.
evidence.payoff: Shot 5 circles an unknown and restates the question; it does not demonstrate why the answer changes the student’s action.
evidence.production: Six timed shots and shootable inserts; Analyze variance is unexplained, and shot 4 recites worksheet punctuation instead of natural student speech.
evidence.originality: The title trap and audit checklist remain familiar.

assessments.automaticTriggerExplanation: No proven material factual error or impossible production instruction. A useful partial insight exists; independent HLNI and differentiation floors fail.
reasons: The six-stage structure passes but does not establish 90+ creative quality.
The full assessment method and meaningful decision consequence remain incomplete.
revisions: Use an accessible, clearly hypothetical academic task and show all three audit columns.
Make the criterion change a visible preparation choice, without assigning invented tasks to a real degree.
Keep form labels on screen and use natural spoken explanation.

evidence.hlni: The missing-source reveal is useful, but “Without a syllabus source, it’s not a fact” confuses absent evidence in the example with falsity or universal source requirements.
evidence.differentiation: The unlabeled task challenge and evidence-gap reveal differ from the Trust worksheet. Connection was unavailable, so full three-channel differentiation remains unverified.
evidence.coherence: The challenge, missing evidence and resulting question stay connected to B.Com vs BBA.
evidence.payoff: The final source question is relevant but does not demonstrate institution/programme/version scope or a concrete decision consequence.
evidence.production: Six shootable shots, but the opening uses the entire four-second speech allowance, and the whiteboard’s empty columns/checkmark add no information.
evidence.originality: A recognizable quiz reveal, without a particularly original execution.

assessments.automaticTriggerExplanation: No external factual audit was performed. The source-language overstatement needs revision; it is not labelled a proven material curriculum error.
reasons: The insight is partially useful but needs epistemic precision and a stronger consequence.
Six ordered stage labels do not satisfy the HLNI floor or the 90+ target.
revisions: Say the card does not provide enough information to assign the task to either degree, rather than declaring it is not a fact.
Show a scoped source request identifying institution, programme and document version.
Replace the empty whiteboard action with a visible correction of the opening guess.

crossChannelFinding: Both complete outputs cover the six required stages. Trust remains worksheet-led; Discovery uses a task challenge. Full three-channel comparison cannot pass without Connection. The accepted drafts retain weak demonstrated consequences and production-language problems.
nextStep: Keep the 85/100 acceptance floor and HLNI/differentiation floors unchanged, with >90 as the improvement target. Do not deploy based on structure alone. Preserve these attempts and validate final-source generation separately.
